digest.component_or_area: CLI bridge noun and verb routing
propositions: The bridge noun group must ship with only preview (read-only) and sync (mutating) verbs functional, with all legacy top-level commands (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor) remaining fully operational.
Callers cannot override the read/write distinction by passing --mode or --filter-local-ids through the bridge foundation.
Mode.py MODE_CAPS and the Mode rank ladder must survive to support the MCP surface and gated_mode reconcile-check compatibility.
No unimplemented verb placeholder is advertised; user guide, CLI reference, and release notes must describe only the staged surface that ships.
Every existing in-repo consumer and legacy command must continue working at the story boundary with no breaking changes to persisted schema.
